what_happened: The operator wrote docs/design/job-planning.md by hand. It designs a planner and critic stage that would run before the producer. The operator based it on a read-only code review and their own critique. It was job 3 of a review split in two. It was committed directly, not run as an Athena job, so the work is on record. An independent Athena review is to follow. No job failed and nothing was rejected. The operator did the design work because Athena has no stage that designs a job before coding.
cause: The pipeline goes straight from an accepted reading to the producer. Nothing in it produces or challenges a design first. Design judgment therefore sits only with the operator. Design work done outside a job is not checked by Athena's verifier. The intervention also depends on the operator remembering to log it.
prevention: Add a planner stage and an independent critic stage between the accepted reading and the producer. The planner writes a design: approach, files affected, risks, and how each acceptance criterion will be checked. The critic reviews it against the repo and the criteria, and the producer starts only on an approved plan. Design-class requests would run through this path as ordinary jobs, with the verifier checking the output. Operator-written designs would no longer be needed, and any that still happen would be logged as interventions.
proposed_request: Implement the planner and critic stage described in docs/design/job-planning.md. After a reading is accepted and before the producer runs, a planner stage writes a job plan covering the approach, the files to change, the risks, and a named check for each acceptance criterion. A separate critic stage reviews that plan against the repo and the criteria. It either approves it or returns specific findings, with a bounded number of revision rounds. The producer must receive the approved plan, and the job must not start the producer without one. Store the plan and the critic's verdict with the job record. Add tests showing that the producer is blocked without an approved plan, that a rejected plan is revised, and that the plan reaches the producer's input. Also review docs/design/job-planning.md independently and report any gaps against the code.
